name: FK Austria Wien
notes: Server-rendered spielplan table (Craft CMS) covers roughly Jun 2026 to Feb 2027 (~6 months ahead, past the 180d horizon). Past-and-future matches are mixed in one table; future ones are identified by goals '-'/'-' and filtered to start>=today. Kickoff time '01:00' is a site placeholder for TBD time, so those emit date-only. Home venue (Generali-Arena, 1100) inferred from FAK logo appearing first in the two-team slot, which reliably tracks home/away; away venue left null. Category is the competition icon's alt text (ÖBL/ÖFB Cup/UECL) with the icon-color suffix stripped; the generic ball icon used for pre-season friendlies has no real competition name so category is null there (all fall outside the current horizon anyway).
